gentle-shell.release_note: Pinned 16 commits after the v3.7.0 tag; those commits are triaged in upstream/SUPPORTED.md. gentle-pi 3.7.0 pins the gentle-ai 3.7.0 binary (scripts/gentle-ai-installer.mjs INSTALLER_VERSION).

odd.description: Compact always-on ODD prompt section and the lazy odd-* skills; canonical gentle-ai routing render for Hermes vendored for drift comparison.

rdd.description: Receipt-driven development for Hermes: /odd_review_mode over the real gentle-ai review mode CLI, the honest rdd-review protocol skill and the receipt-less 4R advisory review (rdd-review-lenses); the native odd_review facade over the gentle-ai review CLI is blocked on upstream runtime eligibility.
rdd.port_notes: T7 ported: /odd_review_mode status|enable|disable wraps `gentle-ai review mode` (schema gentle-ai.review-mode/v1; enable/disable need an explicit --scope global|clone and are explicit user-typed writes of gentle-ai's own switch); the native review availability is probed read-only with `gentle-ai review status --cwd <git repo> --contract gentle-ai.review-integration/v2 --agent hermes --next-transition` (always --agent hermes, never another runtime's identity) and shown by /odd_review_mode, /odd_status and /odd_doctor. skills/rdd-review is an honest Hermes protocol (candidate = one work-unit commit or PR slice; with RDD on, report 'native review unavailable on Hermes' once per candidate, record it in the feature document and continue under ordinary repository policy; no impersonation, no fake receipts). The optional advisory 4R review runs the lens charters of skills/rdd-review-lenses (condensed from gentle-shell assets/agents/review-*.md and assets/chains/4r-review.chain.md, without the Pi ledger/JSON envelope and controller authority) as read-only delegate_task children over `git show <sha>`, labeled 'advisory review — no receipt'. T8 blocked: gentle-ai 3.7.0 refuses --agent hermes with immutable_review_transport_unsupported; the rdd-defect-workflow skills are not derived (their frontmatter declares Apache-2.0).

review-contract.description: Versions of the gentle-ai review CLI contract and of the provider contract mirror that the odd_review facade will speak.
review-contract.capability_note: In gentle-ai v3.7.0 capabilitymanifest the hermes adapter's reviewTransportV1 and immutableReviewExecutorV1 exposures are dormant (ContractReviewTransportV1 / ContractImmutableReviewExecutorV1 are advertised only for claude-code, opencode, codex, pi: runtimes that can launch a fresh, constrained reviewer and prove that boundary before review START). Verified against the gentle-ai 3.7.0 binary (2026-09-25): `gentle-ai review status --cwd <repo> --contract gentle-ai.review-integration/v2 --agent hermes --next-transition` fails in preflight with schema gentle-ai.review-integration.failure/v2, code immutable_review_transport_unsupported, next_action stop, mutation_outcome not_started. The cause lists the runtimes eligible in the probing environment (internal/cli/review_transport_capability.go: pi only with its host relay handshake, opencode only on a V1 runtime), a subset of the compiled set. hermes-odd never passes another runtime's identity; the facade (T8) is blocked on upstream eligibility.

viewers.description: Plain-text viewer and health commands: /odd_agents, /odd_tasks, /odd_changes (Viewers) and /odd_status, /odd_doctor, /odd_commands (Health).
viewers.port_notes: /odd_agents (T3) is a concept port of the gentle-shell Gentle Agents TaskRecord model (extensions/gentle-agents.ts, lib/agents-protocol.ts, lib/agents-view.ts, docs/gentle-agents-activity.md): no upstream code or text is copied, so it carries no derived-from marker. The Pi card, widget and RPC activity transport are not ported. /odd_tasks (T4) is a concept port of the gentle-shell todo card (extensions/gentle-todo.ts, lib/shell-todo.ts) plus the ODD feature document view: it reads odd/tasks/*.md directly and renders plain text; no upstream code or text is copied. The interactive Pi todo tool is not ported: Hermes' native todo tool is used instead. /odd_changes (T5) is a concept port of gentle-shell Gentle Changes (lib/session-changes.ts capture model, lib/shell-changes-view.ts, the Gentle Changes sections of README.md and docs/gentle-shell.md): successful write_file/patch calls captured from Hermes' post_tool_call hook, attributed to main or the subagent, with line counts computed at capture time and no stored content; no upstream code or text is copied. The two-pane diff viewer and before/after snapshots are not ported (Pi TUI; hermes-odd keeps no file content). /odd_status and /odd_doctor (T6) are concept ports of gentle-pi's gentle:status and gentle:doctor (extensions/gentle-ai.ts): one compact status message and a read-only check list with pass/warn/fail marks and remedies, rebuilt for Hermes (gentle-ai binaries on PATH against the lock minimum, RDD mode via `gentle-ai review mode status --json`, SOUL.md size, gentle-ai managed blocks and Hermes' truncation cap, the plugin's own surface, the upstream lock, Hermes); no upstream code or text is copied. The Pi-specific checks (package assets, OpenSpec config, skill registry, model routing, dev binary) are not ported. The RDD mode wording follows gentle-ai's `receipt-driven development: <mode> (decided by <source>)`; the RDD sidebar lifecycle labels of lib/review-sidebar-state.ts (2ac9c68, 8becfd8) describe review lineages and are left for the odd_review facade (T8).

persona.description: First-run setup over chat (the gentle-ai installer's persona step, rebuilt for Hermes): skill hermes-odd:setup (one clarify call), /odd_setup, tool odd_setup_apply, plugin config_schema, and one hermes-odd persona block at the top of SOUL.md with backup and explicit confirmation.
persona.port_notes: T9a: persona texts are hermes-odd's own wording of the upstream behavior rules (no AI attribution in commits, short answers by default, one question at a time, no option menus without a real fork, verify before agreeing, explain why with evidence, alternatives with tradeoffs, persona scope limited to chat with artifacts in English, reply in the user's language, caring and direct mentor tone, concepts before code; Rioplatense voseo or neutral Spanish). Excluded: the '## Identity' product identity, branding, author biography, tool preferences (editor and terminal multiplexers), the Hermes skill-loading and Engram memory sections (Hermes and the T9b Engram skill cover them). Installer presets, component selection and model pickers are not portable (see upstream/SUPPORTED.md). T9b pending: SOUL cleanup of gentle-ai blocks and the lazy Engram protocol skill.

gentle-ai: SDD skills, agents, commands and preflight assets
excluded.reason: hermes-odd ships no SDD in any form (agents, chains, skills, preflight, prompts, gentle-sdd-* commands).
Themes, banners, animations, TUI widgets, keyboard shortcuts and double-esc cancel are Pi terminal UI; Hermes commands answer as plain text on every gateway.

Dev binary, bundled gentle-ai download, telemetry, Pi model profiles and routing, Pi package installers and the Pi in-process reviewer host are Pi-specific; hermes-odd uses the user's installed gentle-ai binary and Hermes' own delegate_task.
They write SDD-heavy content into ~/.hermes/SOUL.md, which Hermes truncates; hermes-odd replaces them with a compact prompt section and lazy skills.
Upstream's own test runners, benchmarks, feature documents and CI do not ship to users.
